stance_basis: suspended right-of-way acquisition pending Final EIS completion, indicating procedural caution rather than opposition or support
summary: The Wisconsin Highway Commission appears in the document primarily in a procedural capacity: it directed staff to prepare an environmental impact statement in October 1972 and then suspended all right-of-way acquisition activity in March 1973 until the Final EIS was completed and approved. These actions reflect regulatory compliance and procedural caution rather than a clear stance for or against the project.
complaint_summary: On October 11, 1972, the Wisconsin Highway Commission directed its staff to prepare and circulate a Draft Environmental Impact Statement in accordance with WEPA guidelines.
summary_quote: March 12, 1973 Wisconsin Highway Commission suspended all right of way acquisition activity until Final Environmental Impact Statement is completed and approved.
